newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine five-month vehicle sales up 1.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine five-month vehicle sales up 1.7 pct.

text.p: Total automobile sales in the Philippines for the first five months of 1997 rose 1.7 percent to 65,226 units from 64,111 units in the same period in 1996, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc (CAMPI) said on Friday.
Earlier this week, CAMPI reporting car sales had said 33,912 units were sold during the five month period, down 5.8 percent from 35,995 in the same period last year.
Friday's statement showing sales of the entire automobile market showed commercial vehicles sales jumped 11.4 percent to 31,314 units from 28,116 during the five-month period.
Leading the automobile market was Toyota Motor Phils, a unit of Toyota Motor Corp, followed by Mitsubishi Motor Phils, a unit of Mitsubishi Motors Corp.
